text:
kai: Heads-up — seeing a correlated burst of PCIe AER events + bus-resets on rack29 nodes, NVLink link flaps shortly after. Pods running embedding jobs show ~30-40% tail latency spikes and some OOM retries. Logs attached below. :eyes:

marta: ugh. which nodes specifically? can we isolate to a single riser / PCIe lane?

kai: looks like node rack29-node07 and rack29-node09 first. pattern: AER correctable, then Xid 34 floods, then nvlink lane dropouts. pasted sample:```[2104567890.987] pcie: AER: Corrected error received: severity=Recovered
[2104567891.012] nvidia 0000:65:00.0: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 34
[2104567891.045] nvlink: link0 lane3 rx_err count++
[2104567891.120] pcie_bus 0000:65:00: bus rescan triggered
```

devon: Did we see temperature or power rail anomalies? NVLink + AER usually points to signal integrity or riser hardware.

kai: temps look normal (GPU junction ~68C), PSU rails steady. Errors correlate with short PCIe bursts during 1s intervals — maybe a loose connector or intermittent slot contact.

alex: can we repro with a synthetic stress test? I can run bandwidth + small transfers to try and trigger it on node07. scheduling now.

marta: i'd recommend draining node07 and node09 from production traffic now to stop user impact. set maintenance tag and trigger autoscaler to reschedule pods to rack28/rack30.

kai: agreed. initiating drains: kubectl cordon node07,node09; drain with --ignore-daemonsets. will also add a node taint so autoscaler doesn't re-add.

sre-bot: @channel automated alert: rack29-node07 cordoned by kai at 2104567905. Autoscaler started rescheduling 18 pods.

devon: good. after drains, let's run pci-e stress + nvlink loopback test. if repro, file RMA for the riser card and schedule swap during maintenance window.

alex: ran a short repro — triggered AER and a nvlink lane rx_err after ~45s of sustained p2p transfers. captured dmesg + nvidia-smi pmon. saving artifacts to s3://rw-infra/buckets/diag/rack29/21045679.

kai: cost impact note: during reschedules we saw 1.2% higher spot usage in us-west-2 for the last hour due to packing inefficiency. not huge but callout for SRE/finance.

marta: next steps: 1) keep nodes drained 2) RMA riser pairs for node07/09 3) BIOS update check for lane retrain fixes 4) run extended pci stress for 2h after swap 5) postmortem if RMA doesn't fix. I'll open an infra ticket and assign RMA to hardware team.

kai: ticket created: INFRA-8421 — "Intermittent PCIe AER -> NVLink link flaps on rack29-node07/09". assigned to hw-team, priority P2. :shipit:

devon: also adding a temporary alert rule to escalate AER counts from corrected->uncorrected threshold: if corrected > 100 in 5m -> page oncall. reduces noisy churn but catches bursts.

alex: noted. i'll attach stress logs and raw nvlink counters to the ticket.

marta: thanks everyone — i'll coordinate RMA/maintenance window tomorrow 03:00-06:00 UTC and post update in #maintenance.

kai: copy. will monitor and uncordon only after clean nvlink/pci logs for 6h. :thumbsup:
